confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is seasonal and volatile. The window is July 2026, which is Okinawa's peak summer season, so the accommodation figures are set toward the higher end of typical ranges. The beer, coffee, and meal anchors are typical Naha ranges converted at roughly 150 JPY per USD. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of mid-sized Japanese leisure cities with a similar mix of domestic tourism and food-service pricing, adjusted to Okinawa's summer peak demand. Naha is treated as comparable to other Kyushu-area regional tourist cities for restaurant pricing, with accommodation weighted toward resort-season rates.
